decisions.reason: Although the firm has strong R&D and learning capacity, this consumer-oriented superfood product appears less central to its core industrial waste-to-value technologies, so management is likely to reallocate resources to areas where its existing knowledge base is stronger.

These modular waste-to-energy extensions fit closely with the firm's established engineering and energy-conversion capabilities, and its in-house R&D and research links make continued improvement and commercialization plausible.

As a flagship waste-oil-to-energy plant squarely within the firm's core knowledge domain, this product is one the firm is well positioned to interpret, refine and scale through its absorptive capacity.

The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is close to the firm's established offer and was presented as a strategic focus, so despite somewhat higher uncertainty than its core lines, management would still be inclined to continue and learn from it.
